result.reason: The transition-assistance obligation reaches the preferred position: up to six months at then-current rates. The clause also requires a commonly used, machine-readable export and subsequent deletion certification. However, the 30-day data-return period runs from Client’s request rather than from expiry or termination, so TrueLink has no automatic obligation to return the data within 30 days after the agreement ends. This misses both the preferred and fallback timing position. Otherwise, the amendment is targeted, preserves unrelated terms, and is professionally drafted.
